Q: Make login from central domain and redirect to tenant with tenancyforlaravel package A:

Isn't it happening because you are losing session context when jumping from central to a subdomain tenant?

Just put it on you .env:
SESSION_DOMAIN=.YOURDOMAIN

this dot before yourdomain tells laravel to share session across subdomains, then you'll not lose context.

Q: Parse Large Json File ( around 300 Mb ) to list of POJO A:

For huge big json file, you should use jackson stream api. You can find the document here. It cost little memory than normal way. In general, your POJO must satisfy certain shapes, it should be able to be separated into many independent parts. Such as a list of object. Then with jackson stream api, you can achieve the object in the list one by one.

Q: Oracle 12c Username forgot A:

If you are able to invoke sqlplus then follow this:

sqlplus:/ as sysdba - this is the command needed to login as sys.

password: - don't give any password. Just hit enter

SQL> select username from dba_users; - this command will give list of users in the database.

Q: Which characters are considered legal for result-document? A:

The href attribute is defined to be a URI reference, not a Windows filename. Saxon has to resolve it against the base URI, which involves manipulating it according to the URI specs, so invalid characters are going to cause problems.

You could try escaping the name using the escape-html-uri() function.
